Q: Magnification of images in vb.net picturebox A:

Here is a fully working code that performs both panning and scaling without flickering:

Imports System.Runtime.InteropServices

Public Class Form1

    <DllImport("user32.dll", CharSet:=CharSet.Auto, SetLastError:=True)>
    Private Shared Function SendMessage(hwnd As IntPtr, Msg As UInteger,
        wParam As IntPtr, lParam As IntPtr) As IntPtr
    End Function

    Const WM_SETREDRAW = 11
    Const SCALE_LVL_MIN = -20
    Const SCALE_LVL_MAX = +20

    Dim scaleLvl As Integer = 0
    Dim _scale As Double = ScaleFromLvl(scaleLvl)

    Dim panning As Boolean = False
    Dim startPanelPoint As Point
    Dim focusPanelPoint As Point
    Dim focusPicturePoint As Point
    Dim startScaleLvl As Integer = scaleLvl
    Dim startScale As Double = _scale
    Dim prevClientSize As Size

    Public Sub New()
        InitializeComponent()
        updatePictureBox()
    End Sub

    Private Sub PictureBox1_MouseDown(sender As Object, e As MouseEventArgs) Handles PictureBox1.MouseDown
        panning = True
        focusPicturePoint = e.Location
        focusPanelPoint = Panel1.PointToClient(PictureBox1.PointToScreen(e.Location))
        startPanelPoint = focusPanelPoint
        startScaleLvl = scaleLvl
        startScale = _scale
    End Sub

    Private Sub PictureBox1_MouseMove(sender As Object, e As MouseEventArgs) Handles PictureBox1.MouseMove
        If panning Then
            focusPanelPoint = Panel1.PointToClient(PictureBox1.PointToScreen(e.Location))
            updatePictureBox()
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub PictureBox1_MouseUp(sender As Object, e As MouseEventArgs) Handles PictureBox1.MouseUp
        If panning Then
            focusPanelPoint = Panel1.PointToClient(PictureBox1.PointToScreen(e.Location))
            updatePictureBox()
            panning = False
        End If
        startScale = _scale
    End Sub

    Private Sub Form1_Deactivate(sender As Object, e As EventArgs) Handles MyBase.Deactivate
        'Applying the current panning when switching to another application (Alt+Tab)
        panning = False
        startScale = _scale
    End Sub

    Public Sub Panel1_MouseWheel(e As MouseEventArgs)
        If Not panning Then
            focusPicturePoint = PictureBox1.PointToClient(Panel1.PointToScreen(e.Location))
            focusPanelPoint = e.Location
            startScale = _scale
        End If
        scaleLvl = MinMax(SCALE_LVL_MIN, scaleLvl + Math.Sign(e.Delta), SCALE_LVL_MAX)
        _scale = ScaleFromLvl(scaleLvl)
        updatePictureBox()
    End Sub

    Private Sub Form1_KeyDown(sender As Object, e As KeyEventArgs) Handles MyBase.KeyDown
        Select Case e.KeyCode
            'Apply the current panning
            Case Keys.Return
                panning = False
            'Return to the position and scale that were at the beginning of panning
            Case Keys.Escape
                If Not panning Then Exit Select
                focusPanelPoint = startPanelPoint
                scaleLvl = startScaleLvl
                _scale = startScale
                updatePictureBox()
                panning = False
        End Select
    End Sub

    Private Sub Panel1_ClientSizeChanged(sender As Object, e As EventArgs) Handles Panel1.ClientSizeChanged
        If Not panning Then
            'Centering the image when resizing
            focusPanelPoint = Panel1.ClientSize / 2
            focusPicturePoint = PictureBox1.PointToClient(Panel1.PointToScreen(prevClientSize / 2))
            startScale = _scale
        End If
        updatePictureBox()
        prevClientSize = Panel1.ClientSize
    End Sub

    Private Sub updatePictureBox()
        'Disabling panel redrawing
        SendMessage(Panel1.Handle, WM_SETREDRAW, False, 0)
        'Simultaneous panning and scaling
        If PictureBox1.Image IsNot Nothing Then
            PictureBox1.Size = New Size(
                PictureBox1.Image.Size.Width * _scale,
                PictureBox1.Image.Size.Height * _scale)
        End If
        Dim ds = Panel1.ClientSize - PictureBox1.Size
        Dim loc = New Point(
            MinMax(ds.Width, focusPanelPoint.X - focusPicturePoint.X * _scale / startScale, 0),
            MinMax(ds.Height, focusPanelPoint.Y - focusPicturePoint.Y * _scale / startScale, 0))
        Panel1.SetDisplayLocation(loc)
        PictureBox1.Location = New Point(
            If(ds.Width >= 0, ds.Width / 2, loc.X),
            If(ds.Height >= 0, ds.Height / 2, loc.Y))
        'Enabling panel redrawing
        SendMessage(Panel1.Handle, WM_SETREDRAW, True, 0)
        'Panel redrawing
        Panel1.AdjustScrollbars()
        Panel1.Refresh()
    End Sub

    Private Shared Function ScaleFromLvl(lvl As Double) As Double
        Return 1.1F ^ lvl   'Discrete level to logarithmic value
    End Function

    Private Shared Function MinMax(min As Integer, val As Integer, max As Integer) As Integer
        Return Math.Max(min, Math.Min(val, max))
    End Function

    Private Shared Function MinMax(min As Double, val As Double, max As Double) As Double
        Return Math.Max(min, Math.Min(val, max))
    End Function

End Class

'Inheritance is necessary for manual scaling by mouse wheel
Friend Class MyPanel
    Inherits Panel

    Protected Overrides Sub OnMouseWheel(e As MouseEventArgs)
        DirectCast(Parent, Form1).Panel1_MouseWheel(e)
    End Sub

    Public Sub SetDisplayLocation(point As Point)
        SetDisplayRectLocation(point.X, point.Y)
    End Sub

    Public Sub AdjustScrollbars()
        AdjustFormScrollbars(True)
    End Sub

End Class

Recommendations for the launch:

  1. Create a new winform desktop application
  2. Place Panel1 on Form1
  3. Set Panel1.AutoScroll = True and Panel1.Anchor or Panel1.Dock = DockStyle.Fill
  4. Place PictureBox1 on Panel1
  5. Set PictureBox1.SizeMode = PictureBoxSizeMode.StretchImage and PictureBox1.Image
  6. Replace the code of Form1.vb file with the one shown above
  7. In Form1.Designer.vb file make the following changes:
Panel1 = New MyPanel()
' ...
Friend WithEvents Panel1 As MyPanel

Q: How to fix wireless debugging failures in Android Studio on Windows 10? A:

This is not a fix but an alternative to the failing Wireless debugging from Android Studio.

Hit the shift key twice to activate the search screen, type plugins and hit enter key

Then in the next screen is the Settings Screen, choose market places in the Plugins Tab and in the search bar, search for ADB Wi-Fi

Choose exactly the one seen in the above image and install, click on apply when done and close the window. Then head to the right panel in your Android Studio and click on the ADB Wi-Fi Icon. Connect your Android phone to the same WiFi your PC is connected, then once again, connect your Android phone to the PC with a USB cable just as you always do for wired debugging. You should see your device visible in list of devices in the ADB Wi-Fi. Click on connect, then disconnect the USB cable, your device can now interact with the PC wirelessly.

Q: Completely hide server name apache A:

Apache Security - Ivan Ristić | Chapter 2.3 Changing Web Server Identity

To confuse the hacker and guess what Linux OS or what version of Apache he is using. You can change the Apache server name to whatever you want.

For ubuntu 20.04:

Apache default configuration:

$ sudo apt install apache2 -y

$ curl -I localhost

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2020 01:31:44 GMT
Server: Apache/2.4.41 (Ubuntu)

Change the Apache server name to whatever you want:

$ sudo apt install libapache2-mod-security2

$ sudo a2enmod security2

$ sudo vim /etc/apache2/conf-available/security.conf

ServerTokens Full

ServerSignature Off

SecServerSignature Microsoft-IIS/10.0 
SecServerSignature FreeBSD-Lighttpd
SecServerSignature Darwin-Caddy
SecServerSignature Unix
SecServerSignature Unix-Caddy

$ sudo systemctl restart apache2

$ curl -I localhost

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2020 01:54:00 GMT
Server: Microsoft-IIS/10.0

$ whatweb http://localhost

HTTPServer[Microsoft-IIS/10.0], IP[127.0.0.1], Microsoft-IIS[10.0]

If the SecServerSignature option is set to SecServerSignature " " This completely hides the apache server name.

$ curl -I localhost

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2020 02:39:50 GMT
Server:

Q: Query fails when Distinct is used A:

If running the query directly in your database or using mysqli_error(), you would have been presented with:

#1064 - You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MySQL server version for the right syntax to use near 'DISTINCT(operator) as operator, FROM Myfactories

Which would have definitively confirmed what you more-or-less knew.

Then you would naturally look to MYSQL documentation to see what specifications DISTINCT has by visiting: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/5.7/en/select.html

14.2.9 SELECT Syntax

[ALL | DISTINCT | DISTINCTROW ]
  [HIGH_PRIORITY]
  [STRAIGHT_JOIN]
  [SQL_SMALL_RESULT] [SQL_BIG_RESULT] [SQL_BUFFER_RESULT]
  [SQL_CACHE | SQL_NO_CACHE] [SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS]
select_expr [, select_expr ...]
[FROM table_references

This means that all of those bracketed keywords must come before any column expressions.

Additional tutorial resources that speak specifically about SELECT DISTINCT on multiple columns include:

  • https://www.w3schools.com/sql/sql_distinct.asp
  • http://www.mysqltutorial.org/mysql-distinct.aspx
  • http://www.w3resource.com/sql/select-statement/queries-with-distinct-multiple-columns.php
  • http://databasechannel.com/AccessArticles/Article_DISTINCT_MultipleColumns.html
  • http://www.sqlservercentral.com/articles/DISTINCT/71551/

Here is one of many, many youtube videos that explain how to use DISTINCT on multiple columns: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-C45IpqUbUA

And if any of those non-StackOverflow resources still didn't do it. Stackoverflow offers many duplicate questions that are in some ways better than anything else on the net.

  • How do I (or can I) SELECT DISTINCT on multiple columns? (A great post because the accepted answer speaks about optimization with GROUP BY)
  • SELECT DISTINCT on multiple columns along with other columns (A great post because the accepted answer speaks about optimization with GROUP BY)
  • Using SELECT DISTINCT in MYSQL (speaks about GROUP BY but not for optimization purposes)

Following the correct adjustment of the DISTINCT keyword, you would have been presented with another error:

#1064 - You have an error in your SQL syntax; check the manual that corresponds to your MySQL server version for the right syntax to use near 'FROM `MyFactories`

The correction of this typo would be to merely remove the , between the factory column and the FROM keyword.

As recommended by other pages on SO, you should use the following for your sql statement as a parameterized statement.

$stmt = $con->prepare(
    "SELECT DISTINCT
         date,
         factory,
         operator
     FROM Myfactories
     WHERE
         factory = ?
         AND `Year` = ?"
);

$year = 2017;
$stmt->bind_param("si", $login_session, $year);
$stmt->execute();

$result = $stmt->get_result();

Q: How to delete elastic search indices older than 30 days using dev tool commands A:

You can simply use the Index life cycle management to automate it.

EDIT You can use the http://es-host:9200/_cat/indices?h=index,creation.date.string to find the indices creation time of all indices in your cluster, once you have all the indices, you can delete them using the delete indices API.
